title: Pennsylvania Powerball Winner Wins $213.8 Million Jackpot
heading: Pennsylvania Hits Powerball Win
description: A Pennsylvania ticket wins the $213.8 million Powerball jackpot. Here are the winning numbers and a list of 2024 Powerball millionaires.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
The American Powerball jackpot has once again found a winner—this time in Pennsylvania. A lucky ticket sold in the state matched all six numbers in the Monday, August 12 drawing, securing a massive $213.8 million prize. For the fortunate ticket holder, the choice is between an annuitized prize of $213.8 million or a lump sum payment of $106.4 million, both before taxes.

The winning numbers for this life-changing draw were 9, 22, 57, 67, 68, with the red Powerball 14. This marks the sixth Powerball jackpot win in 2024 and the 20th time a Powerball jackpot has been won in Pennsylvania since the game launched in 1992.

The Powerball has seen quite the action this year, with several jackpots claimed across the nation. Just last month, a ticket sold in Ohio won a $139.3 million jackpot on July 3. The excitement of these big wins continues to captivate players worldwide.

While this big win is making headlines, it’s important to remember that there are many ways to win with Powerball. In the latest drawing alone, there were 346,939 winning tickets across various prize tiers, including eight $50,000 winners and two $150,000 winners.

Powerball drawings are held every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday. There’s always a chance to join the ranks of Powerball millionaires. With odds of 1 in 292.2 million to win the jackpot, each Powerball drawing offers a chance to dream big. Could the next jackpot winner be you?

Stay tuned and keep playing, because you never know when fortune might smile upon you!
